subject: IaC sanity checks and rollforward playbook for private deployment
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, helen.park@acme-cloud.com
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: IaC sanity checks and rollforward playbook for private deployment

Hi all,

Per the runbook kickoff, we'd like to do a short sanity and safety review of the private deployment IaC bundle before we open the on-prem pilot with Acme next week. High-level goals:

- Confirm Terraform module boundaries and variable scoping (vpc, network, host-bootstrap)
- Validate Helm chart gating (chart testing, schema checks)
- Ensure Ansible roles are idempotent and documented for air-gapped install
- CI gating: tflint/terraform fmt/terraform plan checks, helm lint, ansible-lint, unit & e2e smoke runs
- Define a clear rollforward and rollback playbook with owners and commands

I've attached a quick sanity checklist and the current e2e test matrix for the pilot. Can Aditya and Irene take the module-level review and mark any breaking issues by EOD Tuesday? Helen — can your team share the customer firewall/ACL mapping (CIDR blocks + outbound egress rules) so we can validate the network policy templates?

Proposed meeting: Tue 2027-01-12 10:30am PT — 45m. If that works I'll send an invite.

Thanks,
Jasmine

--
Jasmine Liu
SRE Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: helen.park@acme-cloud.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: IaC sanity checks and rollforward playbook for private deployment

Thanks Jasmine — marking items I picked up after a first pass. Short summary and actions inline:

1) Terraform modules
- vpc-module: ok, but the "public_subnets" variable is mis-documented (CIDR vs index). I'll open a small PR to normalize variable types and add examples.
- host-bootstrap module: current user_data script references a private S3 path; for on-prem it should be optional and default to a local artifact. Action: PR to parametrize artifact_source.
- state backend: we need an explicit note in docs about using the customer's Vault + SFTP for state locking (we can't assume S3).

2) Helm charts
- redwood-priv chart: add a pre-install job that validates networkPolicy templates. I'll add Helm test artifact to CI.
- Values schema: add strict JSON schema and run helm3 lint --strict in pipeline.

3) Ansible roles
- site.yml currently has a task with a non-idempotent shell call for kernel tuning. Replace with sysctl module.
- Add role-level molecule tests for basic converge + verify command.

4) CI gating
- Required checks: terraform fmt, terraform validate, tflint, terraform plan (with planfile check), helm lint --strict, ansible-lint, molecule converge (light), unit tests.
- CircleCI job matrix: add a lightweight plan-only job per PR so maintainers can see delta cost.

5) Rollforward / rollback
- I'll draft commands for canary promotion and an emergency rollback that reverses chart values & re-applies previous terraform state snapshot. Putting this into rollforward-playbook.md (attached).

I've opened the following PRs:
- github.com/redwood-inference/priv-iac/pull/452 (vpc var docs + plan job)
- github.com/redwood-inference/priv-iac/pull/453 (helm strict schema)

I'll finish the detailed playbook by EOD Tuesday and tag Irene for the runbook approval.

- Aditya

[inline: excerpt from PR 452: changed examples and added tfvar snippet]

From: Helen Park <helen.park@acme-cloud.com>

Cc: ops@acme-cloud.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: IaC sanity checks and rollforward playbook for private deployment

Thanks — this looks good. A couple items from Acme ops:

- CIDR mappings: customer will publish the final VPC CIDRs by EOD Monday (we will send a CSV). For now the primary ranges are 10.10.0.0/16 and 10.11.0.0/16.
- Firewall/ACL constraints: outbound HTTPS only to whitelisted artifact mirrors (we cannot allow generic outbound to internet). We'll provide mirror endpoints and IPs.
- On state locking: we can provide an SFTP-based locker and a Vault instance for secrets, however the SRE team will need to provide the SSH key and the locking path.

We can join Tue 10:30am PT. We'll expect a readout of the helm pre-install validation and an example of the rollback commands. Also — are you planning a dry-run deploy into a staging on-prem cluster before pilot? We can host one in our staging DC if helpful.

Regards,
Helen Park
Principal CloudOps Engineer
Acme CloudOps

Subject: Re: IaC sanity checks and rollforward playbook for private deployment

Thanks everyone — short summary and owners (finalized):

- Terraform fixes (aditya_rao): PRs for vpc var docs, host-bootstrap param, and backend docs — target merge Tue EOD. (See PRs 452/453).
- Helm gating (markus_klein): add helm test + strict schema, ship pipeline change to run helm lint in pre-merge job. Target Wed EOD.
- Ansible idempotency (grace_oconnor): replace shell kernel tweaks with sysctl module and add molecule job. Target Thu EOD.
- Network params (Acme ops / helen.park): deliver final CIDR CSV + mirror endpoints by Mon EOD (we have the provisional 10.10.0.0/16 & 10.11.0.0/16).
- CI gating (jasmine_liu): update CircleCI config to require plan-file and add a lightweight plan-only PR job. Target: Fri.

Rollforward playbook (high-level):
1) Canary apply: terraform apply -target=module.canary -var-file=canary.tfvars; helm upgrade --install redwood-priv-canary ./charts/redwood-priv -f canary-values.yaml --wait --timeout 10m
2) Smoke verify: run e2e smoke suite (e2e:smoke) against canary cluster (10–15m)
3) Promote: terraform apply (remaining modules) + helm upgrade --install redwood-priv -f prod-values.yaml
4) Emergency rollback: helm rollback redwood-priv <prev_revision> && apply terraform state from snapshot: terraform state replace-provider ...; revert variable changes and re-apply plan from snapshot.

I've attached a trimmed rollforward-playbook.md with exact commands and recovery checks. Please review and ack once your PRs are green.
